newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia calls on the international community to consider the interests of the oil-producing countries in any decision concerning environmental protection.
- A new 22 million riyal bridge to be constructed to link the Moslem's holiest shrine of Mecca to nearby areas.
- Around 20,000 Saudi tourists expected to visit India this year, compared with 17,000 tourists in 1996.
- Syrian president and Saudi crown prince discuss Arab unity at talks in Damascus.
- Al-Taif governor urges businessmen to support tourism investment plans.
- A summit of Egyptian, Syrian and Saudi leaders expected next month.
- There are 94 joint stock companies in Saudi Arabia with a combined capital of more than 72 billion riyals.
